title: Kolibri: A Sovereign Open-Weight Model
summary:
Aleph Alpha has released "Kolibri," a sovereign, open-weight English-German Mixture-of-Experts Transformer model. Launched on October 3, 2026, Kolibri features 78 billion total parameters (3 billion active) and supports context lengths up to 1 million tokens, available under the Apache 2.0 license on Hugging Face.

Kolibri is specialized for mission-critical work in regulated sectors like public administration, industrials, and aerospace, excelling in German, reasoning, math, and agentic behavior. Its design emphasizes contextualized performance and measurable ROI for customers. Sovereignty is a core tenet, ensured through full supply-chain integrity, transparency, and freedom of deployment, adhering to EU AI Act and GDPR. Built and trained in Germany and Finland under European law, the model features an "I don't know" abstention capability and a native bilingual design with 21.3% German pre-training data.

The model optimizes quality versus serving costs, matching models with up to four times its active parameters across various benchmarks (math, coding, grounding, long-context, agentic tasks). Internal customer-proxy benchmarks show strong performance gains in specific verticals.

Kolibri was developed using Aleph Alpha's "Model Factory," an automated pipeline enabling rapid iteration. In just three months, the team advanced from Kolibri Origin (30B parameters, 65k context, 7.5T training tokens) to Kolibri (78B parameters, 1M context, 20T training tokens). The pipeline's automation handled hardware failures and provided continuous evaluation, highlighting the team's high-velocity LLM development capability. Kolibri uses a hybrid attention mechanism and smaller experts for efficiency, trained on nearly 24 trillion tokens.
chinese_title: 考利布里：主权开放权重模型
chinese_summary:
Aleph Alpha发布了“Kolibri”，这是一个主权、开源权重、英德混合专家Transformer模型。Kolibri于2026年10月3日发布，拥有780亿总参数（其中30亿为活跃参数），支持高达100万个token的上下文长度，并可在Hugging Face上以Apache 2.0许可协议获取。

Kolibri专门用于公共管理、工业和航空航天等受监管行业中的关键任务工作，在德语、推理、数学和代理行为方面表现出色。其设计强调为客户提供情境化性能和可衡量的投资回报率。主权是核心原则，通过完整的供应链完整性、透明度和部署自由来确保，并遵守欧盟人工智能法案和GDPR。该模型在德国和芬兰根据欧洲法律构建和训练，具备“我不知道”的弃权能力，采用原生双语设计，并包含21.3%的德语预训练数据。

该模型优化了质量与服务成本之间的平衡，在各种基准测试（数学、编码、基础能力、长上下文、代理任务）中，其性能与活跃参数高达自身四倍的模型相当。内部客户代理基准测试显示在特定垂直领域有显著的性能提升。

Kolibri是使用Aleph Alpha的“模型工厂”（一个实现快速迭代的自动化流程）开发的。在短短三个月内，团队从Kolibri Origin（300亿参数、6.5万上下文、7.5万亿训练token）升级到Kolibri（780亿参数、100万上下文、20万亿训练token）。该流程的自动化处理了硬件故障并提供了持续评估，突显了团队高速开发大型语言模型（LLM）的能力。Kolibri采用混合注意力机制和更小的专家模型以提高效率，并训练了近24万亿个token。

title: We're going to need default hard budget caps on pretty much everything
summary:
The article strongly advocates for the implementation of "default hard budget caps" on all pay-by-usage services and APIs. The author argues that with the rise of coding and personal agents, it's easier than ever to spin up services that incur costs, leading to a significant risk of users receiving unexpected, massive bills if a service runs away.

Soft caps, which only send warnings, are deemed inadequate as they don't prevent further charges. Instead, the author proposes that services should automatically cut off and return errors once a predefined monthly budget is reached. While some businesses might prefer their applications not to error out, the author contends that most individuals and businesses would choose errors over a surprise $10,000+ bill. Hard caps should be the default, with an explicit, opt-in checkbox required to remove them and accept responsibility for unlimited charges.

AWS is specifically mentioned as a service where this feature is urgently needed, as many users avoid it for personal projects due to fear of runaway costs. Encouragingly, AWS recently (September 2026) launched a "spending limits" feature that pauses projects upon reaching a cap, albeit in a limited release. Google Cloud also introduced "Spend Caps" in July, indicating a positive industry trend. The article concludes by suggesting that future AI agents should recommend providers with hard budget caps and warn users about uncapped services.
chinese_title: 我们将需要对几乎所有一切都设定默认的硬性预算上限。
chinese_summary:
文章强烈主张对所有按使用量付费的服务和API实施“默认硬性预算上限”。作者认为，随着编程和个人代理的兴起，启动产生费用的服务比以往任何时候都更容易，这导致如果服务失控，用户收到意想不到的巨额账单的巨大风险。

仅发送警告的软性上限被认为不足，因为它们无法阻止进一步的收费。相反，作者提出，一旦达到预设的月度预算，服务应自动切断并返回错误。尽管一些企业可能更希望其应用程序不出错，但作者认为，大多数个人和企业会选择错误而不是一张意外的10,000美元以上的账单。硬性上限应为默认设置，并且需要一个明确的、选择性的复选框才能将其移除并接受无限收费的责任。

AWS被特别提及为急需此功能的平台，因为许多用户因担心成本失控而避免将其用于个人项目。令人鼓舞的是，AWS最近（2026年9月）推出了一个“支出限制”功能，该功能在达到上限时会暂停项目，尽管是有限发布。谷歌云也在7月推出了“支出上限”，预示着一个积极的行业趋势。文章最后建议，未来的AI代理应该推荐具有硬性预算上限的提供商，并警告用户关于无上限的服务。

title: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
summary:
Strata enables running the 125-billion-parameter Qwen3.8-Flash-Next AI model on consumer gaming PCs, typically requiring server-grade hardware. It operates entirely locally on your machine, ensuring privacy for tasks like chatting, coding, and image interpretation.

Performance is high, with reply speeds up to 94 tokens/second on an RTX 5070 (12 GB) and projected 100-140 tokens/second on an RTX 3090 (24 GB). Prompt reading is even faster, exceeding 1,000 tokens/second for large documents.

To run Strata, you need an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20/30/40/50 series or compatible AMD Radeon RX 6000/7000/9000 series graphics card with 12 GB VRAM or more. Additionally, 32 GB of RAM (64 GB recommended for all models), 80 GB of SSD storage, and Windows 10/11 or Linux are required.

Installation is straightforward, either via an AI coding assistant or by running a simple script. The installer guides you through model selection (optimized for your RAM, e.g., "Coder" for 32 GB, "IQ2_XS" for 48 GB, "IQ3_S" for 64+ GB), context size, and image reading capabilities. The model download is about 70 GB. Once running, you access Strata through a local browser interface or via an OpenAI-compatible API for integration with other applications.

Strata achieves this by distributing the model's workload across your GPU, RAM, CPU, and SSD, efficiently managing its "experts" and using a "guess-then-check" mechanism for faster text generation. It's free, open-source under the MIT License, and allows for community support.
chinese_title: 在消费级硬件（RTX 4090）上以 100 T/s 运行通义千问 3.8 Flash Next (125B)
chinese_summary:
Strata使得在消费级游戏电脑上运行通常需要服务器级硬件的1250亿参数Qwen3.8-Flash-Next AI模型成为可能。它完全在您的机器上本地运行，确保了聊天、编码和图像解读等任务的隐私。

性能表现出色，在RTX 5070（12 GB）上回复速度高达每秒94个token，预计在RTX 3090（24 GB）上可达每秒100-140个token。提示词读取速度更快，对于大型文档，可超过每秒1000个token。

要运行Strata，您需要一张英伟达GeForce RTX 20/30/40/50系列或兼容的AMD Radeon RX 6000/7000/9000系列显卡，且显存（VRAM）至少12 GB。此外，还需要32 GB的内存（所有模型建议使用64 GB）、80 GB的SSD存储，以及Windows 10/11或Linux操作系统。

安装过程简单直接，可以通过AI编码助手或运行一个简单脚本完成。安装程序会引导您选择模型（根据您的内存进行优化，例如，32 GB内存选择“Coder”，48 GB选择“IQ2_XS”，64 GB及以上选择“IQ3_S”）、上下文大小以及图像读取功能。模型下载大约70 GB。运行后，您可以通过本地浏览器界面或兼容OpenAI的API访问Strata，以便与其他应用程序集成。

Strata通过将模型工作负载分布到您的GPU、内存、CPU和SSD上实现这一点，有效地管理其“专家”并利用“猜测-验证”机制加快文本生成速度。它是免费的，在MIT许可下开源，并支持社区协作。

title: Federal judge calls Flock 'indiscriminate mass surveillance'
summary:
A federal judge has ruled that a Tulsa sheriff’s deputy violated a woman’s Fourth Amendment rights by using Flock Safety to search her license plate without a warrant, deeming it "indiscriminate mass surveillance." Judge Sara Hill stated the deputy had "no apparent reason" for the search beyond the vehicle having a California license plate. As a result, 91 pounds of meth allegedly found after the Flock search must be suppressed as "fruit of a poisonous tree."

While not a binding precedent, this is a significant federal ruling against Flock. Judge Hill criticized the technology for indiscriminately and passively cataloging people's whereabouts, calling it "constitutionally problematic" because it collects information on all vehicles and serves it to law enforcement on demand, rather than being targeted.

This judicial decision adds to a growing chorus of Flock critics. Numerous local and state governments, including Florida and Texas, are discontinuing its use. Senator Bernie Sanders has introduced the "Block Flock Act" to ban federal agencies from using automated license plate readers. Flock CEO Garrett Langley has advocated for a "compromise" between privacy and safety, apologized for law enforcement stalking incidents using the system, and reportedly offered employee buyouts.
chinese_title: 联邦法官称Flock为“无差别大规模监控”
chinese_summary:
一位联邦法官裁定，塔尔萨县治安官的一名副手在没有搜查令的情况下使用Flock Safety搜查一名女性的车牌，侵犯了她的第四修正案权利，并将其认定为“无差别大规模监控”。萨拉·希尔法官表示，除了该车辆悬挂加州车牌外，这名副手进行搜查“没有明显理由”。因此，据称在Flock搜查后发现的91磅冰毒必须作为“毒树之果”予以排除。

尽管这不是一个具有约束力的先例，但这是一项针对Flock的重要联邦裁决。希尔法官批评这项技术不加区别地、被动地记录人们的行踪，称其“在宪法上存在问题”，因为它收集所有车辆的信息并按需提供给执法部门，而不是有针对性的。

这项司法裁决加剧了对Flock的批评声浪。包括佛罗里达州和德克萨斯州在内的许多地方和州政府正在停止使用该系统。参议员伯尼·桑德斯提出了“阻止Flock法案”，旨在禁止联邦机构使用自动化车牌识别器。Flock首席执行官加勒特·兰利主张在隐私和安全之间达成“妥协”，为执法部门利用该系统进行跟踪事件道歉，并据报道提供了员工买断计划。

title: Newgrounds.com – A community of games, music, and art
summary:
Newgrounds.com is a pioneering and long-standing online platform, founded by Tom Fulp in 1995, serving as a dynamic community for user-generated content. It hosts a vast collection of independently produced animations ("Movies"), interactive games, digital art, and original music ("Audio").

The website provides a crucial space for creators to upload their work, gain exposure, and receive feedback from a dedicated community. A hallmark of Newgrounds is its "Blam/Protect" system, which empowers users to moderate content quality and ensure community standards. It played a significant role in the early internet's Flash animation and indie game culture, fostering a generation of artists and developers and giving rise to iconic characters and series such as "Pico" and "Tankmen."

Known for championing artistic freedom, often with an uncensored and experimental edge, Newgrounds continues to be a vibrant hub for independent creators. The platform has adapted to technological changes, embracing HTML5 for games, and remains a testament to grassroots online creativity, providing a unique home for original and diverse artistic expression.
chinese_title: Newgrounds.com：游戏、音乐与艺术社区
chinese_summary:
Newgrounds.com是一个开创性且历史悠久的在线平台，由Tom Fulp于1995年创立，作为一个充满活力的用户生成内容社区。它收录了大量独立制作的动画（“Movies”）、互动游戏、数字艺术和原创音乐（“Audio”）。

该网站为创作者提供了一个重要空间，供他们上传作品、获得曝光并从专门的社区接收反馈。Newgrounds的一个标志性特色是其“Blam/Protect”系统，该系统赋予用户审核内容质量和确保社区标准的权力。它在早期互联网的Flash动画和独立游戏文化中发挥了重要作用，培养了一代艺术家和开发者，并催生了“Pico”和“Tankmen”等标志性角色和系列。

Newgrounds以其倡导艺术自由而闻名，通常带有不经审查和实验性的特点，至今仍是独立创作者的活跃中心。该平台已适应技术变革，在游戏中拥抱了HTML5，并且仍然是草根在线创造力的证明，为原创和多样化的艺术表达提供了一个独特的家园。
